description.en: Schedules a story event to run next. The event type must be "STD" (the standard events); any other type is refused. With overwrite, the event already scheduled is cleared first. The request is stored with the event ID and a Replace setting of 1. The ev_main helper ReserveEvent wraps it.
true to clear the event already scheduled first.

true once scheduled.
null if the type is not "STD", the request could not be stored, the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.
